# ai-native-sdlc

> Alpha release, aimed at regulated teams (fintech, payments, medtech). Open-source Claude Code skill and plugin implementing Anthropic's "The AI-native SDLC playbook": intent, spec, plan, build, verify, PR review and gated release, with human approval gates, guard hooks and a git audit trail. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Docs
- [How it works](https://yuri-geronimus.github.io/ai-native-sdlc/how-it-works): stages, gates, tiers, folder layout
- [Guide](https://yuri-geronimus.github.io/ai-native-sdlc/guide): setup and daily use
- [FAQ](https://yuri-geronimus.github.io/ai-native-sdlc/faq): common questions
- [Configuration](https://yuri-geronimus.github.io/ai-native-sdlc/configuration): sdlc.json reference
- [Design decisions](https://yuri-geronimus.github.io/ai-native-sdlc/design-decisions): choices and known limits
